layers.name: NASA POWER
layers.use: Historical temperature and rainfall; load on Dashboard.

layers.name: Köppen–Geiger v2
layers.resolution: 1 km; product period must be specified
layers.use: Climate class, not crop suitability. Manual class is unverified.

layers.name: FAO GAEZ v5
layers.use: Crop/input/water-regime-specific suitability; never a generic zone-to-crop lookup.

layers.name: FAO HWSD v2
layers.use: Mapped soil context; not measured field pH or SOM.

layers.name: NASA SMAP
layers.use: Surface-moisture context needs QA and Earthdata access.

layers.name: Copernicus Sentinel-2
layers.use: NDVI time series needs quality filtering and cannot diagnose disease.
